projectPlan.purpose: To manage product inventory, track stock levels, visualize stock distribution, and perform CRUD operations with local storage persistence.
projectPlan.targetAudience: Small business owners, warehouse managers, and retail administrators.
features: Dashboard with key metrics (Total Products, Low Stock Alerts, Total Value, Out of Stock items)
Interactive Inventory Chart showing stock levels per category
Product CRUD operations (Create, Read, Update, Delete) with LocalStorage persistence
Stock status indicators with color-coded badges (In Stock, Low Stock, Out of Stock)
futureRefinements: Multi-user authentication and role-based access control
Supplier management and purchase order tracking
deferredWorkflows: Advanced reporting and historical stock level analytics
Automated reorder notifications and supplier integration

# inventory-management-dashboard

This is a generated frontend MVP built with Vanilla HTML/CSS/JS and Vite.

## Getting Started

1. Install dependencies:
   ```bash
   pnpm install
   ```
2. Run the development server:
   ```bash
   pnpm run dev
   ```

# Public API Keys (must be prefixed with VITE_)
VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:3000
